sections.title: Mastering Paragraph & Character Styles
content: In Adobe InCopy, typography styles serve as the architectural foundation of editorial consistency. Layout designers define master styles in InDesign, allowing editors to seamlessly apply them without accidentally breaking publication design guidelines.
Paragraph styles govern entire text blocks (headings, subheads, body copy), whereas Character styles pinpoint inline exceptions such as bold lead-ins, citations, or italic emphasis.

sections.title: Track Changes & Editorial Revisions
content: The Track Changes ecosystem empowers teams to monitor every editorial revision, strike-through, and insertion with surgical precision.
Editors and copy-chiefs can accept or reject individual edits, leave reviewer comments, and maintain comprehensive audit trails for team-wide transparency.

cards.title: Enabling Track Changes
cards.description: Navigate to Window > Editorial > Track Changes to reveal the panel, then activate tracking with a single click.

cards.title: Story View Workflow
cards.description: Utilize Story View (Ctrl+Y / Cmd+Y) to inspect raw editorial copy and revisions without visual distraction from complex layout graphics.
